    <!DOCTYPE html>
    <html lang="en">
    <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
    <title>Clinical Trials Knowledge Graph</title>
    <!-- vis-network -->
    <script src="https://unpkg.com/vis-network/standalone/umd/vis-network.min.js"></script>
    <!-- Fonts -->
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
    /* --- compacted & production-ready styling (keeps original look) --- */
    *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;font-family:Inter,system-ui,Segoe UI,Roboto,Arial,sans-serif}
    :root{
    --primary:#6366f1;--primary-2:#8b5cf6;--bg:#fff;--card:#fff;--muted:#64748b;--text:#1e293b;
    --card-dark:#0f1724;--bg-dark:#071026;--muted-dark:#94a3b8;--text-dark:#f8fafc;--border:#e6eef9;
    --trials:#6366f1;--conditions:#ec4899;--treatments:#10b981;--measures:#f59e0b;
    --shadow: 0 6px 22px rgba(16,24,40,0.06);
    }
    body{height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);transition:.2s}
    body.dark{background:var(--bg-dark);color:var(--text-dark)}
    header{height:70px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--card),#f3f4f6)}
    body.dark header{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--card-dark),#111827);border-color:#263243}
    .logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-weight:700}
    .logo-icon{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--primary),var(--primary-2));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(99,102,241,0.2)}
    .logo-icon:before{content:"";width:18px;height:18px;background:#fff;border-radius:50%}
    .search-container{max-width:520px;flex:1;margin:0 20px;position:relative}
    .search-input{width:100%;padding:10px 40px;border-radius:10px;border:2px solid var(--border);background:transparent}
    .search-icon{position:absolute;left:12px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:18px;height:18px;opacity:.6}
    .search-clear{position:absolute;right:12px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);cursor:pointer;opacity:0.6;display:none}
    .header-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
    .btn{border-radius:10px;padding:8px 12px;border:none;background:transparent;cursor:pointer}
    .btn-primary{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--primary),var(--primary-2));color:#fff}
    .main-container{display:flex;flex:1;overflow:hidden}
    .sidebar{width:280px;border-right:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--card);display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:width .25s}
    body.dark .sidebar{background:var(--card-dark);border-color:#263243}
    .sidebar.collapsed{width:80px}
    .sidebar-header{padding:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
    .sidebar-content{padding:16px;overflow:auto;flex:1}
    .sidebar-section{margin-bottom:18px}
    .sidebar-section-title{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
    .slider-container{margin-bottom:12px}
    .slider-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:6px;color:var(--muted)}
    .slider{width:100%}
    .color-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px}
    .color-item{height:44px;border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:inset 0 -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)}
    .graph-container{flex:1;padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
    .graph-header{padding:12px 16px;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#f8fafc);border:1px solid var(--border)}
    .graph-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:700}
    .graph-visualization{position:relative;flex:1;border-radius:14px;background:var(--card);box-shadow:var(--shadow);overflow:hidden}
    #network-container{position:absolute;inset:0}
    .graph-controls{position:absolute;right:16px;top:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;z-index:10}
    .control-btn{border-radius:10px;padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--card);cursor:pointer}
    .graph-legend{position:absolute;right:16px;bottom:16px;background:var(--card);padding:10px;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);display:flex;gap:12px;border:1px solid var(--border)}
    .legend-color{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:6px}
    .loading-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.9);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:20}
    body.dark .loading-overlay{background:rgba(6,10,18,0.9)}
    .spinner{width:56px;height:56px;border:5px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.12);border-left-color:var(--primary);border-radius:50%;animation:spin 1s linear infinite;margin-bottom:10px}
    @keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
    .node-details{position:absolute;left:16px;bottom:16px;width:310px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);z-index:12;display:none}
    .badge{display:inline-block;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:999px;background:#f3f4f6;font-size:12px;margin-right:6px}
    /* responsive */
    @media (max-width:900px){.sidebar{display:none}.search-container{display:none}}
    </style>
    </head>
    <body>
    <!-- Header -->
    <header>
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px">
    <div class="logo">
    <div class="logo-icon" aria-hidden></div>
    <div>Clinical Trials KG</div>
    </div>
    </div>
    <div class="search-container" style="max-width:700px">
    <svg class="search-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"/></svg>
    <input id="search-input" class="search-input" placeholder="Search nodes, labels, groups, NCT IDs..." />
    <button id="clear-search" class="search-clear" title="Clear search" aria-label="Clear search" style="display:none">
    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"><line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"/><line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/></svg>
    </button>
    </div>
    <div class="header-actions">
    <button id="theme-toggle" class="btn tooltip" title="Toggle theme">
    <svg id="theme-icon" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"><path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z"/></svg>
    </button>
    <button id="export-btn" class="btn btn-primary">Export</button>
    </div>
    </header>
    <!-- Main -->
    <div class="main-container">
    <aside id="sidebar" class="sidebar" aria-hidden="false">
    <div class="sidebar-header">
    <div class="sidebar-title">Graph Controls</div>
    <button id="sidebar-toggle" class="btn">«</button>
    </div>
    <div class="sidebar-content">
    <!-- PHYSICS -->
    <div class="sidebar-section">
    <div class="sidebar-section-title">Physics</div>
    <div class="slider-container">
    <div class="slider-header">
    <div>Gravity</div>
    <div id="gravity-value">50%</div>
    </div>
    <input id="gravity-slider" class="slider" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="50">
    </div>
    <div class="slider-container">
    <div class="slider-header">
    <div>Node spacing</div>
    <div id="spacing-value">70%</div>
    </div>
    <input id="spacing-slider" class="slider" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="70">
    </div>
    </div>
    <!-- APPEARANCE -->
    <div class="sidebar-section">
    <div class="sidebar-section-title">Appearance</div>
    <div class="color-grid">
    <div class="color-item" style="background:#6366f1"></div> <!-- Trials -->
    <div class="color-item" style="background:#ec4899"></div> <!-- Conditions -->
    <div class="color-item" style="background:#10b981"></div> <!-- Treatments -->

    <div class="color-item" style="background:#8b5cf6"></div> <!-- Populations -->
    <div class="color-item" style="background:#64748b"></div> <!-- Default -->
    </div>
    </div>
    <!-- DATA -->
    <div class="sidebar-section">
    <div class="sidebar-section-title">Data</div>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap">
    <button id="data-source-btn" class="btn btn-outline">Data Source</button>
    <button id="save-graph-btn" class="btn btn-outline">Save</button>
    </div>
    </div>
    <!-- DIVIDER -->
    <div style="height:1px;background:var(--border);margin:14px 0"></div>
    <!-- ABOUT -->
    <div class="sidebar-section">
    <div class="sidebar-section-title">About</div>
    <div style="font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--muted)">
    This interactive knowledge graph visualizes structured relationships between clinical trials, conditions, treatments, populations, and outcome measures.
    It enables explainable trial discovery, comparison, and relationship-driven exploration for research and decision support.
    </div>
    </div>
    </div>
    </aside>
    <main class="graph-container">
    <div class="graph-header">
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center">
    <div>
    <div class="graph-title">Knowledge Graph Visualization <a href="https://github.com/ranjeetkulkarni/AI-KnowledgeGraph-ClinicalTrialRecommender"
    target="_blank"
    style="font-size:12px;color:var(--primary);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500">
    View Project on GitHub →
    </a>
    </div>
    <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)">Explore relationships between clinical trials, conditions, and treatments. Search nodes and zoom in to reveal relationship types.</div>
    </div>
    </div>
    </div>
    <div class="graph-visualization">
    <div id="loading-overlay" class="loading-overlay">
    <div class="spinner"></div>
    <div style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px">Loading graph</div>
    <div style="width:260px;height:8px;background:#eef2ff;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:6px">
    <div id="progress-bar" style="width:0%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--primary),var(--primary-2))"></div>
    </div>
    <div id="progress-text" style="color:var(--muted)">Initializing...</div>
    </div>
    <div class="graph-controls">
    <button id="zoom-in" class="control-btn" title="Zoom in">+</button>
    <button id="zoom-out" class="control-btn" title="Zoom out">−</button>
    <button id="fit-graph" class="control-btn" title="Fit graph">Fit</button>
    <button id="reset-physics" class="control-btn" title="Reset physics">Reset</button>
    </div>
    <div class="graph-legend" aria-hidden>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center"><div class="legend-color" style="background:var(--trials)"></div><div style="font-size:13px">Trials</div></div>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center"><div class="legend-color" style="background:var(--conditions)"></div><div style="font-size:13px">Conditions</div></div>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center"><div class="legend-color" style="background:var(--treatments)"></div><div style="font-size:13px">Treatments</div></div>
    </div>
    <div id="network-container"></div>
    <div id="node-details" class="node-details" aria-hidden>
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:start;margin-bottom:8px">
    <div style="font-weight:700" id="node-title">Node</div>
    <div class="badge" id="node-type">Type</div>
    </div>
    <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:8px">ID</div>
    <div id="node-id" style="margin-bottom:10px;font-weight:600">—</div>
    <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:6px">Connections</div>
    <div id="node-connections">—</div>
    </div>
    </div>
    </main>
    </div>

    // ---- Utility: color presets per group ----
    const colorPresets = {
    trials: '#6366f1', // strong blue (hub)
    conditions: '#ec4899', // pink
    treatments: '#10b981', // green
    measures: '#d97706', // amber (NOT yellow)
    populations: '#8b5cf6', // purple
    default: '#94a3b8' // soft slate, not baby blue
    };
    function nodeColorFor(node) {
    if (node.group && colorPresets[node.group]) return colorPresets[node.group];
    return colorPresets.default;
    }
    function inferGroupFromEdge(label) {
    if (!label) return 'default';
    const upper = label.toUpperCase();
    // Check in priority order - most specific first
    if (upper.includes('HAS_CRITERIA')) return 'conditions';
    if (upper.includes('EVALUATES')) return 'treatments';
    if (upper.includes('INVOLVES')) return 'populations';
    if (upper.includes('MEASURES')) return 'measures'; // Check last!
    return 'default';
    }

    // sampleEdges.forEach((e, idx) => {
    // edges.add({
    // id: 'e' + idx,
    // from: e.from,
    // to: e.to,
    // label: e.label,
    // color: { color: 'rgba(80,80,80,0.18)' },
    // arrows: 'to',
    // font: { align: 'middle' }
    // });
    // });
    // // capture original colors
    // nodes.get().forEach(n => originalNodeColors.set(n.id, JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(n.color))));
    // edges.get().forEach(e => originalEdgeColors.set(e.id, e.color));
    // }
    function seedData() {
    // 1️⃣ PRE-PROCESS: Map every node ID to its incoming edge labels
    // This tells us "what" a node is based on how it's connected
    const nodeRelationships = {};
    sampleEdges.forEach(e => {
    if (!nodeRelationships[e.to]) {
    nodeRelationships[e.to] = [];
    }
    nodeRelationships[e.to].push(e.label);
    });
    // Helper to determine group based on edge labels
    function getGroup(id, existingGroup) {
    // Rule 1: NCT IDs are ALWAYS trials (Blue)
    if (String(id).startsWith('NCT')) return 'trials';
    // Rule 2: If the data already has a specific group, keep it
    if (existingGroup && existingGroup !== 'default') return existingGroup;
    // Rule 3: Infer group from incoming edges
    const labels = nodeRelationships[id] || [];
    // Priority order matters here!
    if (labels.some(l => l.toUpperCase().includes('MEASURES'))) return 'measures'; // Orange
    if (labels.some(l => l.toUpperCase().includes('EVALUATES'))) return 'treatments'; // Green
    if (labels.some(l => l.toUpperCase().includes('HAS_CRITERIA'))) return 'conditions'; // Pink
    if (labels.some(l => l.toUpperCase().includes('INVOLVES'))) return 'populations'; // Purple
    return 'default'; // Light Blue
    }
    // 2️⃣ ADD NODES (Apply the logic above)
    // We use a Set to track added IDs so we don't add duplicates later
    const addedIds = new Set();
    sampleNodes.flat().forEach(n => {
    const id = String(n.id ?? n.label);
    if (addedIds.has(id)) return; // skip duplicates
    const group = getGroup(id, n.group);
    const color = colorPresets[group] || colorPresets.default;
    nodes.add({
    id: id,
    label: n.label || id,
    title: n.title || n.label || id,
    group: group,
    shape: 'dot',
    size: group === 'trials' ? 24 : 14, // Make trials slightly bigger
    color: {
    background: color,
    border: shade(color, -15),
    highlight: { background: color, border: '#000' }
    },
    font: {
    color: document.body.classList.contains('dark') ? '#f8fafc' : '#1e293b'
    }
    });
    addedIds.add(id);
    });
    // 3️⃣ CREATE MISSING NODES FROM EDGES
    // (For nodes mentioned in edges but missing from sampleNodes)
    sampleEdges.forEach(e => {
    [e.from, e.to].forEach(id => {
    if (!addedIds.has(id)) {
    const group = getGroup(id);
    const color = colorPresets[group] || colorPresets.default;
    nodes.add({
    id: id,
    label: id,
    group: group,
    shape: 'dot',
    size: group === 'trials' ? 24 : 16,
    color: {
    background: color,
    border: shade(color, -15)
    }
    });
    addedIds.add(id);
    }
    });
    });
    // 4️⃣ ADD EDGES
    sampleEdges.forEach((e, i) => {
    edges.add({
    id: 'e' + i,
    from: e.from,
    to: e.to,
    label: e.label,
    arrows: 'to',
    color: { color: 'rgba(120,120,120,0.2)' },
    font: { align: 'middle', size: 10 }
    });
    });
    // 5️⃣ SAVE ORIGINAL COLORS (for search reset)
    nodes.get().forEach(n =>
    originalNodeColors.set(n.id, JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(n.color)))
    );
    edges.get().forEach(e =>
    originalEdgeColors.set(e.id, e.color)
    );
    }
    // tiny shade helper (lighten/darken hex)
    function shade(hex, percent) {
    try {
    const c = hex.replace('#','');
    const num = parseInt(c,16);
    const r = Math.max(Math.min(((num >> 16) + percent),255),0);
    const g = Math.max(Math.min(((num >> 8 & 0x00FF) + percent),255),0);
    const b = Math.max(Math.min(((num & 0x0000FF) + percent),255),0);
    return '#' + ( (1<<24) + (r<<16) + (g<<8) + b ).toString(16).slice(1);
    } catch(e){ return hex; }
    }
    // ---- Network initialization ----
    function initNetwork() {
    const container = document.getElementById('network-container');
    const data = { nodes, edges };
    const options = {
    nodes: { shape: 'dot', size: 18, borderWidth: 2, font: { face: 'Inter' } },
    edges: { width: 2, smooth: { type: 'continuous' }, arrows: { to: { enabled: true, scaleFactor: 0.6 } } },
    physics: {
    enabled: true,
    barnesHut: {
    gravitationalConstant: -2000,
    centralGravity: 0.25,
    springLength: 180,
    springConstant: 0.04,
    damping: 0.09
    },
    stabilization: { enabled: true, iterations: 700, updateInterval: 50 }
    },
    interaction: { hover: true, tooltipDelay: 100, navigationButtons: false, keyboard: true },
    layout: { improvedLayout: true }
    };
    try {
    network = new vis.Network(container, data, options);
    network.on('stabilizationProgress', params => {
    const p = Math.round((params.iterations / params.total) * 100);
    progressBar.style.width = p + '%';
    progressText.textContent = p + '%';
    });
    network.on('stabilizationIterationsDone', () => {
    progressBar.style.width = '100%';
    progressText.textContent = '100%';
    setTimeout(() => { loadingOverlay.style.display = 'none'; network.fit({ animation: { duration: 400 } }); }, 350);
    });
    network.on('click', params => {
    if (params.nodes && params.nodes.length) {
    showNodeDetails(params.nodes[0]);
    } else {
    nodeDetails.style.display = 'none';
    }
    });
    network.on('doubleClick', params => {
    // If double-click node, center on it
    if (params.nodes && params.nodes.length) {
    network.focus(params.nodes[0], { scale: 1.4, animation: true });
    }
    });
    } catch (err) {
    console.error('vis init error', err);
    loadingOverlay.style.display = 'none';
    }
    }
    // ---- UI helpers ----
    function showNodeDetails(nodeId) {
    const n = nodes.get(nodeId);
    if (!n) return;
    nodeTitleEl.textContent = n.label || nodeId;
    nodeTypeEl.textContent = n.group || 'node';
    nodeIdEl.textContent = nodeId;
    const connected = network.getConnectedNodes(nodeId);
    nodeConnectionsEl.textContent = (connected && connected.length) ? `${connected.length} connections` : 'None';
    nodeDetails.style.display = 'block';
    }
    // ---- Search & highlight ----
    let highlightTimer = null;
    function resetHighlighting() {
    // restore node colors ONLY (no camera movement)
    nodes.get().forEach(n => {
    const orig = originalNodeColors.get(n.id);
    if (orig) nodes.update({ id: n.id, color: orig });
    });
